utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s getting some traction. I can swing by after errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check what’s left once I’m back, and I can help sort the bigger jobs first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just bring the drill and the spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll bring them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, as far as I know, but I’m still checking the timing and logistics.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — can you confirm the timing before I head over?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive. I might be a bit fuzzy on the details, but I’m here and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, I’ve got the supply list here. Come by and I’ll show you what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll stop by and take a look at the list with you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I say yes, can you remind me what’s included in the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: It’s the usual stuff: fixing up small things like loose hinges, squeaky doors, and patching little wear-and-tear issues. I might be forgetting a detail or two, though.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That helps, but I’d still like the full list before I agree.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Jules. What’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Just the last bit of the drywall and a box of screws. If you grab the drill, we can finish it quick.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, I’ll grab the drill and help finish the drywall.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll grab my drill and head over after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, I’ll be ready when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I know where the repair drive is headed, but I’ll need the exact drop-off spot before I can help more.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll get you the exact drop-off spot as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good. Once you have it, send me the exact spot and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive's picking up steam again, and folks are dropping off tools and snacks at the community center this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll swing by after lunch and spread the word—happy to bring anything folks still need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I’ll spread the word too and ask if anyone still needs a hand with hauling or setup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the repair drive start, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure of the start time, but you should probably bring gloves, a mask, and any tools you have.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks - is there a specific start time or meeting point?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing, Nell — I’m on the repair drive and I’ll pass the plan along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik. Let me know once the plan is ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll tell Nell the plan is ready and send it along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli. I’m keeping the repair drive list organized, and I can slot your help in wherever it’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do that. I’ve got some time to help where it’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll put you where the list needs it most and keep you posted on the tasks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, there’s been a steady stream of folks heading over for the repair drive. I heard they’re still looking for a few more hands this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can lend a hand for an hour or two. Point me to the list, and I’ll take the next straightforward task.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, the list is on the table by the back window. Start with the broken chair leg if you want the cleanest first job.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late - what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s moving along, but we still need a few hands and some parts. I’m checking what’s left and I’ll let folks know the next step.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, keep me posted if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is moving along. What part needs the most help right now?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The biggest help right now is hands and a few tools. A lot of the repairs are small, but there are too many of them for me to manage alone.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. Tell me which tools are still missing, and I’ll see what I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll head over and take a look at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll check the drive and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive is picking up again tomorrow, and I can help connect anyone who wants to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds good, Jules. Can you check what kind of help they need tomorrow, and whether there’s a sign-up list?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check with the organizers tomorrow about what help they need and whether there’s a sign-up list, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I heard something about that, but I might’ve missed the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yeah, it’s the repair drive this Saturday at the community center. I can send you the details if you want them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, yeah, Saturday at the community center works for me. Send me the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is moving along. Need me to swing by and drop anything off?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I can use a hand. Bring whatever tools you’ve got and I’ll put them to work.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, I’ll grab my tools and head over.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll bring the drive over.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, I’ll take a look as soon as you drop it off.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We should make sure we have enough people and a clear drop-off plan before we start, or this repair drive could get messy.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many people do we actually have so far, and where are we setting up the drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We don't have a firm count yet, so I don't want to guess. If we can confirm the volunteers and pick one clearly marked drop-off spot, we can keep this from turning into a mess.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I heard the repair drive is happening soon, and I’m telling everyone I can. Want me to put your name on the list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, put me on the list. I can bring a few supplies too if you still need help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ve got you on the list. I’ll make sure to tell everyone you’re bringing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate if you tell me what time the repair drive starts and what I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think it starts at six, and just bring any tools you can spare.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll bring what tools I can spare and be there at six.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell. I’ve got the repair drive sheet ready, and I’ll keep the pickups organized so we can make the biggest dent today.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good, Rosa. Just point me to where I can help, and I’ll follow your lead.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll put you at the donation table by the curb, and we can keep the boxes moving from there.
